dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fit on the trailing edge indicating a falcate geometry with a moderate curvature towards the posterior.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow pixel radius at the morphological tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 60-70 degree incline relative to the dorsal horizontal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.1 times the vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow convexity with a large radius arc, indicating a low-profile melon structure.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Proportionally short and thick rostrum; pixel length from inflection point to tip is nearly equal to the vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle where the melon slope meets the rostrum, measured at approximately 150 degrees.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan/teal monochromatic luminescence across the entire surface area with a lack of biological skin texture or natural countershading.
